purpose: Owner VoiceOver settings changed for the H-12 smoke and restored afterwards.

allowVoiceOverAppleScript.ownerAction: administrator authentication to enable (22:09 local) and to disable again

voiceOverAfter: off: method VOICEOVER_QUIT_THEN_SWITCH (VoiceOver's quit, then its System Settings switch), verified by NSWorkspace and the absence of its process (restore.json)
automationConsent: VoiceOver's scripting answered from the first scripted run, so Terminal holds Automation access to VoiceOver from a one-time owner consent; it is inert while VoiceOver scripting is off and was left in place rather than resetting all of Terminal's Apple-event grants
